values.note: Every site in all five campgrounds, Campground 5 included, is on the reservation system (online up to 12 months ahead, or 877-422-6766); no minimum stay. Unreserved sites can be taken on a walk-up basis. Campgrounds 2-5 take reservations only in their own seasons. 15 days in any 30.

note: Trout park with five campgrounds: #1 with full hookups beside the spring branch in the valley, open all year, and #2-#5 up a steep hill in the woods. Family sites hold two camping units. --Claude
